summary.headline: Spot VIX stress broadened into the monthly curve, then partially faded; 18-18.5 remains the key front pivot.
key_points: VIX traded 16.26-17.55 and ended near 16.38; October forward reached about 18.39 and ended near 18.08.
Prior-session OI confirms both Oct18P long normalization inventory (+20k) and Oct17P short-put/floor inventory (+19k).
Jan19 synthetic-long from the prior session is strongly confirmed by OI and receives an exact-size continuation.
Current flow is structurally mixed: large Nov/Dec normalization put ratios coexist with Oct 20/30 disaster convexity and a dominant Dec35C tail sale.
Headline signed delta is -$12.4M but flips positive if the dominant 35C tail package is excluded.
summary.daily_note: Main regime: failed clean normalization, wider front stress, but late retracement and retained carry structures prevent a clean broad risk-off classification.

leave_one_out.comment: Total signed delta is -$12.388M; excluding the dominant Nov/Dec35 package changes it to +$13.612M. Headline delta is therefore package-dependent.

levels.label: 15 LOW-VIX RATIO TARGET / RISK ZONE
levels.interpretation: Large Nov and Dec put ratios target normalization toward 15 while becoming vulnerable to a deeper collapse below roughly 14.3-14.6.

levels.label: 18-18.5 MAIN MONTHLY PIVOT
levels.interpretation: October forward traded around 18.35-18.39 during stress and ended near 18.08; this zone separates normalization from renewed stress acceptance.

levels.label: 19-20 CORRECTION / INVENTORY
levels.interpretation: Fresh 19.5C OI from the prior session is confirmed; 20C is the short leg of a large 1x3 tail backspread and remains a major inventory node.

levels.label: 22 ORDINARY STRESS SUPPLY
levels.interpretation: Historical repeated OI-confirmed call supply remains relevant; current November 22C is also sold in repeated 22/32 spread-like packages.

levels.label: 30 TAIL CONVEXITY WING
levels.interpretation: October 30C is bought in an approximately 1x3 backspread against short 20C; next OI is needed to separate fresh tail hedging from short covering.

levels.label: 35-40 EXTREME TAIL BOUNDARY
levels.interpretation: The Oct20/30 backspread becomes favorable above roughly 35; simultaneously Dec35C sees a very large sale and January 40C is bought.

structures.interpretation: Near-zero-cost ~1x3 call backspread: sells ordinary 20-30 VIX stress while retaining disaster convexity above roughly 35.1. Current BUY30C may also include short covering because prior 30C OI fell.
Large put ratio targeting VIX normalization toward 15, financed by heavy 15P sales. If opened as one package, the downside risk accelerates below roughly 14.59.
1x6 put ratio buys normalization toward 15 and finances it by selling deep lower-VIX puts; approximate lower breakeven is 14.33 if fresh opening.

Repeated exact 1x2 geometry. If the missing 17P side was SELL, this is an almost zero-cost normalization ratio targeting 17 with a lower breakeven near 15.05. Missing aggressor prevents a directional conclusion.
Short synthetic almost exactly at the October forward, reinforced by 20C supply. It is direct front-VIX normalization flow, subject to next-OI confirmation.
Two repeated equal-size spread prints. If the missing 32C side is BUY, this sells ordinary November stress at 22 while capping tail risk at 32.
Near-flat-cost correction hedge: buy 25C, finance with short 16P and short 36C. It protects moderate stress while selling both low-VIX and extreme-tail outcomes.

The November 35C legs cancel directionally while December 35C is sold 2x size. This is the dominant headline package and is best treated as a cross-expiry tail reshape rather than standalone November flow.
Exact-size continuation of the January 19 synthetic-long book that was strongly OI-confirmed from the prior session.
